description: Buddy Adaptive Intelligence — Phase 2 of self-improvement. Builds on the learning loop foundation (Phase 1) to add model versioning, portfolio optimization, regime-aware behavior, and operational monitoring.

userStories.title: Fix RL feedback loop — agent weights reload on every scan
userStories.description: As a learning system, agent weights must reload from disk before each scan so trade outcomes actually change future behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: ScannerAgentTeam has reload_learned_weights() method that re-reads agent_weights.json
Scanner.scan() calls agent_team.reload_learned_weights() at start of each cycle
End-to-end test: trade win → weight increase → reload → higher weight used in next scan
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL BUG FIX. Weights were saving to disk but Scanner never reloaded them. Fixed 2026-03-18.

userStories.title: Pre-trade backtest validation gate (soft confidence penalty)
userStories.description: As a trading system, I need to validate each signal against recent candle history before execution to catch model degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: BacktestGate class at src/scanner/backtest_gate.py with validate() method
Simulates entry on last 20 candles with given SL/TP, calculates win rate
If win_rate < 55%: apply -15% confidence penalty (soft gate, never hard-blocks)
Integrated into engine.py _scan_pair() after specialist agents, before caching
Thread-safe, < 1ms per pair, graceful degradation on missing data
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Soft gating pattern matches uncertainty agent. Built 2026-03-18.

userStories.title: Model A/B testing framework with version control
userStories.description: As a learning system, I need to safely test new model versions against the incumbent before promoting to production.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/model_manager.py with ModelManager class
ModelManager.register_version(model_path, metadata) stores model with version tag
ModelManager.shadow_test(candidate_version, n_scans=50) runs candidate in parallel with incumbent, compares accuracy
Automatic promotion: if candidate beats incumbent by >2% accuracy on 50+ scans, swap models
Version history logged to trained_data/models/version_history.jsonl
Rollback: ModelManager.rollback(version_tag) instantly reverts to any previous version
Integrated into ContinuousScanner: after every 50th scan, check if candidate ready for promotion
userStories.notes: Implemented 2026-03-18. Direction encoding fixed 2026-03-19 (LONG/SHORT/HOLD uniform). Shadow predictions now logged to shadow_predictions.jsonl. score_from_trade_outcome wired into learning loop.

userStories.title: Regime-aware agent weighting (per-regime RL)
userStories.description: As a learning system, agent weights should vary by volatility regime so the right experts lead in each market condition.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain 3 weight sets in agent_weights.json: NORMAL, HIGH, EXTREME
When trade closes, update ONLY the regime's weight set that was active at entry
When scanning, load weights for current volatility regime
Dynamic multipliers: in EXTREME vol, momentum weight *= 1.3, mean_reversion *= 0.7
Regime change detection triggers weight reload and observation log entry
Fallback: if regime-specific weights have < 10 trades, use global weights
userStories.notes: Confirmed implemented 2026-03-19. get_weights_for_regime(), _migrate_legacy_weights(), _init_regime_weights() all present in agents.py. agent_weights.json has NORMAL/HIGH/EXTREME/_global structure.

userStories.title: Dynamic pair rotation with rolling Sharpe
userStories.description: As a trading system, I should prioritize pairs with best recent performance and deprioritize underperformers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/portfolio_optimizer.py with PortfolioOptimizer class
Calculate 50-trade rolling Sharpe ratio per pair
Rank pairs: top 7 by Sharpe are 'active', bottom pairs are 'observe-only' (scan but don't trade)
Correlation-based check: if portfolio USD exposure > 40%, pause additional USD pairs
Pair rotation runs every 10 scan cycles (not every scan — too volatile)
Log rotation decisions to observations.jsonl
userStories.notes: Implemented: portfolio_optimizer.py (432 lines). Wired into ContinuousScanner._apply_pair_rotation(). Rolling Sharpe, 7-pair cap, 40% USD exposure limit, 10-cycle rotation, ObservationLog integration. Verified 2026-03-22.

userStories.title: Real-time alert system for operational monitoring
userStories.description: As an operator, I need alerts when the system crosses risk thresholds so I can intervene before large drawdowns.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/scanner/automation/alert_manager.py with AlertManager class
Alert triggers: drawdown >5%, 3+ consecutive losses, win rate drop >10% (20-trade rolling), agent weight instability (>0.3 change in one cycle)
Alert channels: log to alerts.jsonl + optional email via existing email infrastructure
Alert cooldown: same alert type suppressed for 1 hour after firing
Integrated into ContinuousScanner: check alerts after every trade sync
Alert state persists across sessions (stored in .claude/alert_state.json)
userStories.notes: Implemented: alert_manager.py with 4 trigger types, JSONL logging, cooldown suppression, file locking, state persistence. Wired into ContinuousScanner. Verified 2026-03-22.
